headline: Voted 3-0 on an agreement related to the Conant Thread District, subject to minor revisions; soup kitchen design/build RFP tabled.
summary: No public input was given. Members tabled the Soup Kitchen design/build RFP. After executive session, members reported a 3-0 vote on an agreement related to the Conant Thread District, subject to minor revisions.
decisions: Tabled the Soup Kitchen design/build RFP.
Voted 3-0 to approve an agreement related to the Conant Thread District, subject to minor revisions.

decision_evidence.quote: It was reported that the Agency voted 3-0 on an agreement related to the Conant Thread District, subject to minor revisions.

decision_titles: Agreement related to the Conant Thread District
plain_text:
Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency 
Meeting Minutes 
October 16, 2026, 8:00 AM 
 
 
Call to Order 
The meeting was called to order at 8:00 a.m. 
 
Roll Call 
A quorum was established.  In attendance:  Larry Monastesse, Mark McLaughlin, Monika 
Zuluaga 
 
Others:  Jason Pezzullo, Timothy Chapman, Mary Bourdeau, Nico Corbo, Jason Alderman 
Zoom:  Mark Hayward, Jeanne Boyle 
 
Public Input Session – None 
 
Old Business 
Soup Kitchen – Design/Build RFP – Tabled 
 
 
Motion to go into Executive Session 
 
Mr. McLaughlin made a motion to go into Executive Session Pursuant to RI Gen L § 42-46-5 
(2013) (5) Any discussions or considerations related to the acquisition or lease of real 
property for public purposes, or of the disposition of publicly held property wherein 
advanced public information would be detrimental to the interest of the public – Item:  
Conant Thread District, seconded by Ms. Zuluaga.  Motion passed 3-0. 
 
Mr. McLaughlin made a motion to seal the minutes of the Executive Session, seconded by Ms. 
Zuluaga.  Motion passed 3-0. 
  
Mr. McLaughlin made a motion to return to Open Session, seconded by Ms. Zuluaga.  
Motion passed 3-0. 
  
 
Upon the Agency's return to open session, the members present were advised of the action 
taken in executive session.  
 
1.  It was reported that the Agency voted 3-0 on an agreement related to the Conant Thread  
      District, subject to minor revisions.  
 
Adjournment  
Mr. McLaughlin made a motion to adjourn the meeting, seconded by Ms. Zuluaga.  Motion 
carried 2-0.
